tldr: The Moon in Cancer: emotions are deep, protective, and rooted in belonging.
body: With the Moon in Cancer, feelings need tenderness, memory, family, home, and emotional continuity. The Moon is at home here, so instinct and care are powerful when they are not used as armor.
gift: Nurturing intelligence, intuition, devotion, and the ability to create emotional safety.
challenge: Moodiness, defensiveness, and caretaking as a way to avoid asking for care.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
